---
title: "Balance comercial"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    scrolling: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  # Controla cuántos países se muestran en la sección "Países seleccionados".
  # El criterio de selección es el comercio total acumulado: exportaciones + importaciones.
  max_countries: 12
  include_country_sections: true
  include_country_categories: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(glue)
library(htmltools)
library(stringr)

# Resolver rutas de forma tolerante:
# - Al renderizar desde dashboard/: ../r y ../data
# - Al renderizar desde la raíz del proyecto: r y data
resolve_existing_path <- function(...) {
  paths <- c(...)
  existing <- paths[file.exists(paths)]

  if (length(existing) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No se encontró ninguna de las rutas esperadas:\n",
      paste0("- ", paths, collapse = "\n"),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  existing[[1]]
}

functions_path <- resolve_existing_path(
  "../r/02_functions_plots.R",
  "r/02_functions_plots.R"
)

data_path <- resolve_existing_path(
  "../data/dashboard/trade_balance_lac.rds",
  "data/dashboard/trade_balance_lac.rds"
)

source(functions_path)

if (!exists("plot_trade_balance")) {
  stop(
    "No se encontró la función `plot_trade_balance()` en `r/02_functions_plots.R`.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

trade_balance_lac <- readRDS(data_path)

# Validaciones mínimas solicitadas.
if (!is.data.frame(trade_balance_lac)) {
  stop(
    "El archivo `trade_balance_lac.rds` se cargó, pero no contiene un data frame válido.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

check_required_columns(
  data = trade_balance_lac,
  required_cols = c(
    "year",
    "ref_area_code",
    "ref_area_name",
    "ref_area_type",
    "hc_cat2",
    "exports_1000usd",
    "imports_1000usd",
    "balance_1000usd"
  ),
  data_name = "trade_balance_lac"
)

if (nrow(trade_balance_lac) == 0) {
  stop(
    "La base `trade_balance_lac` se cargó correctamente, pero no contiene filas.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

available_areas <- trade_balance_lac |>
  distinct(ref_area_code, ref_area_name, ref_area_type) |>
  filter(!is.na(ref_area_code), !is.na(ref_area_name)) |>
  arrange(ref_area_name)

if (nrow(available_areas) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No hay áreas disponibles en `ref_area_code` / `ref_area_name` para construir el dashboard.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

available_hc_cat2 <- trade_balance_lac |>
  distinct(hc_cat2) |>
  filter(!is.na(hc_cat2)) |>
  arrange(hc_cat2) |>
  pull(hc_cat2)

if (length(available_hc_cat2) == 0) {
  stop(
    "No hay categorías disponibles en `hc_cat2` para construir el dashboard.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (!"LAC" %in% available_areas$ref_area_code) {
  stop(
    "No se encontró el agregado regional `LAC` en la columna `ref_area_code`.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Etiquetas de categorías para tabs. `NULL` se usa para que plot_trade_balance()
# agregue todas las categorías disponibles; esto equivale a "Total productos".
category_items <- tibble::tibble(
  label = c("Total productos", available_hc_cat2),
  value = c(NA_character_, available_hc_cat2)
)

# Países seleccionados según comercio total acumulado.
# Se excluye el agregado LAC para no duplicar la sección regional.
max_countries <- params$max_countries
if (is.null(max_countries) || is.na(max_countries) || max_countries < 1) {
  max_countries <- 12
}

selected_countries <- trade_balance_lac |>
  filter(ref_area_code != "LAC") |>
  group_by(ref_area_code, ref_area_name, ref_area_type) |>
  summarise(
    trade_total_1000usd = sum(exports_1000usd + imports_1000usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(trade_total_1000usd), ref_area_name) |>
  slice_head(n = max_countries)

# Utilidades locales livianas para construir tabs HTML estáticas.
# No redefinen la lógica gráfica: sólo organizan widgets ya producidos por
# plot_trade_balance().
sanitize_id <- function(x) {
  x |>
    stringr::str_to_lower() |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "-") |>
    stringr::str_replace_all("^-|-$", "")
}

safe_plot_trade_balance <- function(area_code, category_value = NA_character_) {
  selected_hc_cat2 <- if (is.na(category_value)) NULL else category_value

  tryCatch(
    {
      plot_trade_balance(
        data = trade_balance_lac,
        selected_area = area_code,
        selected_hc_cat2 = selected_hc_cat2,
        interactive = TRUE
      ) |>
        plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE)
    },
    error = function(e) {
      div(
        class = "alert alert-warning",
        strong("No fue posible construir este gráfico."),
        br(),
        "Área: ", area_code,
        br(),
        "Categoría: ", ifelse(is.na(category_value), "Total productos", category_value),
        br(),
        "Detalle: ", conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )
}

make_category_tabset <- function(area_code, id_prefix) {
  tab_ids <- paste0(id_prefix, "-", sanitize_id(category_items$label))

  nav_tabs <- tags$ul(
    class = "nav nav-tabs",
    role = "tablist",
    purrr::pmap(
      list(category_items$label, tab_ids, seq_along(tab_ids)),
      function(label, tab_id, i) {
        tags$li(
          class = "nav-item",
          role = "presentation",
          tags$button(
            class = paste("nav-link", if (i == 1) "active" else NULL),
            id = paste0(tab_id, "-tab"),
            `data-bs-toggle` = "tab",
            `data-bs-target` = paste0("#", tab_id),
            type = "button",
            role = "tab",
            `aria-controls` = tab_id,
            `aria-selected` = if (i == 1) "true" else "false",
            label
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )

  tab_content <- tags$div(
    class = "tab-content pt-3",
    purrr::pmap(
      list(category_items$label, category_items$value, tab_ids, seq_along(tab_ids)),
      function(label, value, tab_id, i) {
        tags$div(
          class = paste("tab-pane fade", if (i == 1) "show active" else NULL),
          id = tab_id,
          role = "tabpanel",
          `aria-labelledby` = paste0(tab_id, "-tab"),
          safe_plot_trade_balance(area_code = area_code, category_value = value)
        )
      }
    )
  )

  tagList(nav_tabs, tab_content)
}

make_country_tabset <- function(countries_tbl, include_categories = TRUE) {
  if (nrow(countries_tbl) == 0) {
    return(
      div(
        class = "alert alert-info",
        "No se encontraron países distintos del agregado LAC para esta sección."
      )
    )
  }

  country_ids <- paste0("country-", sanitize_id(countries_tbl$ref_area_code))

  nav_tabs <- tags$ul(
    class = "nav nav-tabs",
    role = "tablist",
    purrr::pmap(
      list(countries_tbl$ref_area_name, country_ids, seq_along(country_ids)),
      function(country_name, country_id, i) {
        tags$li(
          class = "nav-item",
          role = "presentation",
          tags$button(
            class = paste("nav-link", if (i == 1) "active" else NULL),
            id = paste0(country_id, "-tab"),
            `data-bs-toggle` = "tab",
            `data-bs-target` = paste0("#", country_id),
            type = "button",
            role = "tab",
            `aria-controls` = country_id,
            `aria-selected` = if (i == 1) "true" else "false",
            country_name
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )

  tab_content <- tags$div(
    class = "tab-content pt-3",
    purrr::pmap(
      list(countries_tbl$ref_area_code, countries_tbl$ref_area_name, country_ids, seq_along(country_ids)),
      function(country_code, country_name, country_id, i) {
        country_body <- if (isTRUE(include_categories)) {
          make_category_tabset(
            area_code = country_code,
            id_prefix = paste0(country_id, "-cat")
          )
        } else {
          safe_plot_trade_balance(
            area_code = country_code,
            category_value = NA_character_
          )
        }

        tags$div(
          class = paste("tab-pane fade", if (i == 1) "show active" else NULL),
          id = country_id,
          role = "tabpanel",
          `aria-labelledby` = paste0(country_id, "-tab"),
          tags$h4(country_name),
          country_body
        )
      }
    )
  )

  tagList(nav_tabs, tab_content)
}

# Al cambiar de tab, algunos widgets plotly ocultos pueden requerir resize.
# Este pequeño script fuerza el redimensionamiento al activar una pestaña.
plotly_tab_resize_js <- tags$script(HTML(
  paste0(
    "document.addEventListener(\'shown.bs.tab\', function () {\n",
    "  window.dispatchEvent(new Event(\'resize\'));\n",
    "});"
  )
))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plotly_tab_resize_js
```

## Row

### Column

```{r}
#| label: lac-category-tabs
make_category_tabset(area_code = "LAC", id_prefix = "lac")
```

### Column

```{r}
#| label: country-tabs
if (isTRUE(params$include_country_sections)) {
  make_country_tabset(
    countries_tbl = selected_countries,
    include_categories = isTRUE(params$include_country_categories)
  )
} else {
  div(
    class = "alert alert-info",
    "La sección de países fue desactivada mediante `params$include_country_sections = false`."
  )
}
```
